ops.why: 809 is turned in at Ak'Zeloth and then abandoned; 924 is the one-object follow-up.
ops.text: Accept The Demon Seed from Ak'Zeloth before you leave Far Watch Post. The altar is west of here, and you have to come back to the same orc to finish.

ops.why: The only objective is the Altar of Fire. Do it on this visit so Far Watch is not a second trip.
ops.text: Use the Flawed Power Stone at the Altar of Fire, then go straight back to Ak'Zeloth. If the stone expires, a replacement exists, but it is the same errand.

sources.label: QuestieDB object 3525 The Altar of Fire spawn

ops.why: Turn-in is the same NPC as 809, so the Crossroads ride starts after this hub is finished.
ops.text: Turn in The Demon Seed to Ak'Zeloth, then take the road to the Crossroads. Do not stay for the repeatable stone unless the first one expired.

ops.why: 926 is repeatable and only replaces an expired Flawed Power Stone.
ops.text: If the Flawed Power Stone expires before you reach the altar, pick up the replacement stone. That repeat is not a second quest line.

ops.why: Complete step has no goto. Exploration has no pin; the Forgotten Pools mushroom cluster is the matching landmark.
ops.text: Run west to the Forgotten Pools and explore the water. The laden mushrooms on the bank are the same pool you will pick over later for spores.

sources.label: QuestieDB object 3640 Laden Mushroom, northern cluster

ops.why: Witchwing harpies are on the ridge beside Walton. The current step runs back there after The Escape ends in Ratchet.
ops.text: Kill the Witchwing harpies for Harpy Raiders while you are still at Walton, before you ride east to Wizzlecrank's shredder.

sources.label: QuestieDB npc 3276-3280 spawns on the northern ridge
OpenXP Barrens guide id order: harpies before the shredder return

ops.place: 039 after barrens-12-20:043; 040 after barrens-12-20:045 and before barrens-12-20:046
ops.why: Parts piles sit on the same south shore as the freebooters and Baron Longshore. The route walks that shore twice.
ops.text: Accept the Ratchet kill and wanted quests before you leave town, loot the parts piles on the pirate shore, and turn the parts in on the same return as the freebooters.

ops.why: Root Samples is a herbalism skill quest. The route gives it to everyone and never completes it.
ops.text: Skip Root Samples unless you are herbalism. It is a profession pick, and this route has no complete step for it.

ops.why: Barak stands next to Regthar. The route accepts Kolkar Leaders, rides south, then comes back.
ops.text: Kill Barak Kodobane as soon as you accept Kolkar Leaders, turn the head in to Regthar, and do not ride back here after the scytheclaw nests.

sources.label: QuestieDB npc 3394 Barak Kodobane single spawn

ops.why: 875 is accepted at the Crossroads and turned in after the hearth with no kill step.
ops.text: Kill Witchwing Slayers for the lieutenant rings before you turn Echeyakee back in. The turn-in at the Crossroads is already later in the route.

sources.label: QuestieDB item 5065 drops from npc 3278; spawn 38.91, 14.31

ops.why: Serena and Letter to Jin'Zil are the Stonetalon breadcrumb. Guides that do them also open a full mountain route.
ops.text: After the lieutenant rings, Darsok offers Serena Bloodfeather and then a letter to Jin'Zil in Stonetalon. Skip both. Stonetalon mobs start in the mid-teens if the Barrens hubs feel packed, but do not level there yet.

ops.why: Sputtervalve is already the Samophlange giver. 1483 is one talk into Windshear Crag.
ops.text: Sputtervalve can send you to Ziz Fizziks in Stonetalon. Take that talk only as a pointer. Leave the Windshear quests for the Stonetalon route.

ops.why: Gazrog's next quest is one chest. Every free guide takes it; this route stops at Raptor Thieves.
ops.text: When you turn in Raptor Thieves, accept Stolen Silver from Gazrog. It is one chest south of the road, not a second raptor grind.

ops.why: The chest is southeast of the scytheclaw nests, on the same southern loop.
ops.text: Open the Stolen Silver chest southeast of the raptor nests while you are already in the south for the scytheclaws.

ops.why: The next Crossroads stop is the scytheclaw turn-in, so Gazrog is the same visit.
ops.text: Turn Stolen Silver in to Gazrog on the same Crossroads stop as The Angry Scytheclaws.

ops.why: One corpse on the south road. The follow-up is a quillboar collection, so it stays a tip.
ops.text: Mankrik at the Crossroads offers Lost in Battle. The beaten corpse is at 49.33, 50.32, on the way toward Camp Taurajo. Skip Her Name Is Olgra after it; that one wants four quillboar drops.

sources.label: QuestieDB npc 10668 Beaten Corpse; quest 95774 pre 4921

ops.why: 907 and 913 are short camp kills. 874 and 873 are the long tail, so they are not steps.
ops.text: After Ishamuhale, Jorn offers Enraged Thunder Lizards and then Cry of the Thunderhawk. Stormsnouts are at 48.92, 51.37 and a thunderhawk hatchling is at 46.76, 50.95. Stop before Mahren Skyseer.
